clock.scope: Same host and original direct-child launch; actual per-trace frequency is 1e9. Window membership is by clock, not an external business-cycle identity join.

definition: BeginImmediate public phase exit through Commit public phase exit for creates that inserted an item; managed proxy, not exact physical SQLite lock ownership.
method: Clip each recorded operation interval to the same per-create proxy, union overlaps within each segment and again across all segments; retain cross-segment overlap and uncovered remainder. No quantile addition. Nearest-rank descriptive quantiles.

window.selection: Managed BeginImmediate-exit through Commit-exit wholly inside the original first-dispatch through last-completion interval; cross-boundary spans counted separately.
Managed BeginImmediate-exit through Commit-exit wholly inside the original first-dispatch through last-completion interval; cross-boundary spans counted separately.

scope_limits: Proxy starts after Begin has completed and its managed retirement has been observed; it ends after Commit and its managed retirement. Physical writer-lock acquisition/release timestamps are not recorded.
Start to terminal includes managed control setup, provider/runtime execution and callback delivery; native BEGIN pending is not a physical SQLite lock measurement.

Terminal to take includes scheduling and control readiness; take to retired includes result materialization, retirement/quiescence retry and continuation observation. The trace does not label the time of each timer tick or native pending retry.
The measured-window group is a time-selected set of managed create spans. It cannot be paired to a particular external cycle latency, which includes three HTTP calls.
One profiled load per role does not establish an improvement or regression beyond noise, capacity, long-duration acceptance, or a singular cause.
